## Description

Primary source:

<https://ngs101.com/single-cell-rna-seq-beginners-guide-part-5-cell-type-specific-differential-expression-proportion-testing-and-functional-pathway-analysis/>

Part 4 of 4. Individual genes may change modestly while a whole pathway shifts.
Each cell is scored for the expression of one or more MSigDB gene sets with
`AddModuleScore()`; scores are then averaged per sample and cell type, and
conditions are compared with a t-test across samples (so that samples, not
cells, are the replicates).

The article scores one gene set, `HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE`. Here the gene
sets are a YAML list (`params$genesets`) and are looped over; the default is the
article's single gene set. The article loads `fgsea` but never uses it, so it is
not loaded here.

**Limitation:** the per-sample t-test is unpaired and has no covariates. It also
uses few samples (4 vs 4), so treat the p-values as a screen.

Code is taken from the source article's code blocks. Changes made for this
notebook series: hard-coded values moved into the YAML front matter, paths built
from `params` rather than `setwd()`, and the fixes marked `FIX:` in comments.

## Libraries and directories

```{r step1_libs_data}

# Core single-cell analysis
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)

# Functional analysis
library(msigdbr)

# Visualization and data manipulation
library(ggplot2)
library(ggridges)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

if (!exists("params") || !is.list(params)) {
  # Running interactively (e.g. via "Run Cell") rather than through
  # knit/render, so `params` was never created by rmarkdown::render().
  # Reconstruct it by parsing this .Rmd's own YAML header, so the params
  # defaults live in exactly one place (the YAML block above) instead of
  # being duplicated here.
  rmd_path <- tryCatch(
    # Only reliable when this document is the active editor tab; if focus
    # has moved to another file, this will pick up the wrong path.
    rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path,
    error = function(e) NA_character_
  )
  if (is.na(rmd_path) || !nzchar(rmd_path)) {
    # Fallback if rstudioapi is unavailable or no doc is focused; assumes
    # the working directory is the project root.
    rmd_path <- "scRNAseq_tutorial_5_differential_analysis/tut5_differential_analysis_part4.Rmd"
  }
  params <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(rmd_path)$params
}

# Set working directory
base.dir <- params$base.dir
diff.dir <- file.path(base.dir, params$diff.subdir)

# Create output directories
for (d in c("plots/functional_scoring", "results")) {
  if (!dir.exists(file.path(diff.dir, d))) dir.create(file.path(diff.dir, d), recursive = TRUE)
}

# Set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(params$seed)

# Configure plotting defaults
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 12))

# Column names, condition levels and colors from params
celltype.col <- params$celltype.col
sample.col <- params$sample.col
condition.col <- params$condition.col
cond.ref <- params$condition.ref
cond.test <- params$condition.test
condition.colors <- setNames(unlist(params$condition.palette), c(cond.ref, cond.test))
```

## Load annotated Seurat object from tutorial 4

```{r step2_load_obj}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 2: Load annotated Seurat object from tutorial 4
#-----------------------------------------------

annotated.file <- file.path(base.dir, params$annot.subdir, params$annotated.rds)
cat("Reading in annotated Seurat object:", annotated.file, "\n")
seurat_obj <- readRDS(annotated.file)

stopifnot(all(c(celltype.col, sample.col, condition.col) %in% colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)))
stopifnot(all(c(cond.ref, cond.test) %in% seurat_obj@meta.data[[condition.col]]))

DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"
cell_types <- sort(unique(as.character(seurat_obj@meta.data[[celltype.col]])))
```

## Download gene sets from MSigDB

Gene sets of roughly 15-200 genes score well with `AddModuleScore()`.

```{r step3_genesets}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 11: Download gene sets from MSigDB
#-----------------------------------------------

# Split "collection:gene_set_name" entries from params
gs_requests <- strsplit(unlist(params$genesets), ":", fixed = TRUE)
stopifnot(all(lengths(gs_requests) == 2))
gs_requests <- data.frame(collection = sapply(gs_requests, `[`, 1),
                          gs_name = sapply(gs_requests, `[`, 2))

# msigdbr >= 10 names this argument `collection`; older versions use `category`
get_msigdb <- function(species, collection) {
  tryCatch(msigdbr(species = species, collection = collection),
           error = function(e) msigdbr(species = species, category = collection))
}

geneset_list <- list()
for (coll in unique(gs_requests$collection)) {
  gene_sets <- get_msigdb(params$species, coll)
  for (gs in gs_requests$gs_name[gs_requests$collection == coll]) {
    genes <- gene_sets %>% filter(gs_name == gs) %>% pull(gene_symbol) %>% unique()
    if (length(genes) == 0) {
      warning("Gene set not found in collection ", coll, ": ", gs)
      next
    }
    # Only genes present in the object can contribute to the score
    geneset_list[[gs]] <- genes
    cat(gs, ":", length(genes), "genes,", sum(genes %in% rownames(seurat_obj)), "present in object\n")
  }
}
stopifnot(length(geneset_list) > 0)
```

## Score cells

```{r step4_score}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 12: Score cells with AddModuleScore
#-----------------------------------------------

score_cols <- character()
for (gs in names(geneset_list)) {
  # Seurat appends "1" to the name for the first feature list
  tag <- make.names(gs)
  seurat_obj <- AddModuleScore(
    seurat_obj,
    features = list(geneset_list[[gs]]),
    name = tag,
    nbin = params$modulescore.nbin,
    ctrl = params$modulescore.ctrl
  )

  # Rename for clarity
  score.col <- paste0(tag, "_Score")
  colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)[colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data) == paste0(tag, "1")] <- score.col
  score_cols[gs] <- score.col
}
print(score_cols)
```

## Visualize pathway scores by cell type and condition

```{r step5_ridge, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 13: Visualize scores
#-----------------------------------------------

for (gs in names(score_cols)) {
  # Ridge plot showing score distributions by cell type and condition
  p_ridge <- ggplot(seurat_obj@meta.data,
                    aes(x = .data[[score_cols[[gs]]]],
                        y = .data[[celltype.col]],
                        fill = .data[[condition.col]])) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(title = paste(gs, "scores"),
         x = "Pathway Score",
         y = "Cell Type",
         fill = "Condition") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition.colors)
  print(p_ridge)

  ggsave(file.path(diff.dir, "plots/functional_scoring", paste0("ridge_", gs, ".png")), p_ridge,
         width = 10, height = 8, dpi = params$plot.dpi)
}
```

## Statistical testing of pathway scores (pseudobulk approach)

```{r step6_pathway_tests}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 14: Pseudobulk statistical testing of pathway scores
#-----------------------------------------------

# Function to test one cell type for one score column
test_pathway_celltype <- function(celltype, score_data) {
  # Filter to this cell type
  ct_data <- score_data %>% filter(.data[[celltype.col]] == celltype)

  # FIX: return the same columns on every path (the article's early return
  # included a `significant` column that the normal return lacked, which makes
  # the later rbind() fail)
  empty <- data.frame(cell_type = celltype, mean_ref = NA_real_, mean_test = NA_real_,
                      diff = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_)

  if (nrow(ct_data) < params$score.min_rows) return(empty)

  # Separate by condition
  ref_scores <- ct_data %>% filter(.data[[condition.col]] == cond.ref) %>% pull(mean_score)
  test_scores <- ct_data %>% filter(.data[[condition.col]] == cond.test) %>% pull(mean_score)

  # t.test needs at least 2 observations per group
  if (length(ref_scores) < 2 || length(test_scores) < 2) return(empty)

  # Statistical test (t-test)
  test_result <- t.test(test_scores, ref_scores)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = celltype,
    mean_ref = mean(ref_scores),
    mean_test = mean(test_scores),
    diff = mean(test_scores) - mean(ref_scores),
    p_value = test_result$p.value
  )
}

pathway_results_all <- list()
for (gs in names(score_cols)) {
  # Aggregate scores by sample and cell type
  score_aggregated <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>%
    group_by(.data[[sample.col]], .data[[condition.col]], .data[[celltype.col]]) %>%
    summarise(mean_score = mean(.data[[score_cols[[gs]]]]), .groups = "drop")

  # Test all cell types
  pathway_tests <- lapply(cell_types, test_pathway_celltype, score_data = score_aggregated)
  pathway_results <- do.call(rbind, pathway_tests)

  # Add FDR correction across cell types
  pathway_results$FDR <- p.adjust(pathway_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  pathway_results$gene_set <- gs

  # Save results
  write.csv(pathway_results, file.path(diff.dir, "results", paste0(gs, "_pathway_test.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
  pathway_results_all[[gs]] <- pathway_results

  cat("\n", gs, "\n")
  print(pathway_results, row.names = FALSE)
}

write.csv(bind_rows(pathway_results_all),
          file.path(diff.dir, "results/pathway_tests_all_gene_sets.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
